title: Rejected Task Status
description: A rejected task status will allow us to explicitly mark tasks when we've changed our minds or human review steps in.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Added Rejected as a first-class task status constant, task list/detail dropdown option, and task-record validator value. Added API regression coverage proving Rejected keeps tasks unarchived and uncompleted while preserving status-change history notes. Validation passed: focused TasksApi_CanSetRejectedStatusWithoutCompletingOrArchivingTask test passed 1/1 and Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 passed over 170 task records.
